text: I converted via Giyur KHalacha. I paid for the course some little money, something like 600 shekels? For a 10 month course. After you complete your giyur, you can apply to change of a status, which is these 3k. You dont have to, but for example I wanted. I am in the middle of the process with Misrad hapnim. The 3k is the court fees. Also I paid a money for a kallah lessons, because you need to have a chupah after the giyur. Many do so the same day of the beit din and mikveh.
